mapper.select: SELECT d.*, u.real_name AS operator_name FROM quality_defect_dispose d LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = d.operator_id WHERE d.defect_id = #{defectId} ORDER BY d.id ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO quality_defect_dispose (defect_id, dispose_plan, operator_id, operate_at, result_desc, verify_status) VALUES (#{defectId}, #{disposePlan}, #{operatorId}, NOW(), #{resultDesc}, 0)
